capabilities: Installs DSH and missing tools (git, Node.js, pnpm) with one click
Starts, monitors and restarts the DSH service in the background
Embeds the DSH web UI in an Obsidian panel
Injects note selections into the DSH chat and opens DSH-produced files in Obsidian
Serves the panel over LAN HTTPS for phones and other devices
disambiguation: Not the DSH agent itself; it installs, runs and embeds the separate DeepSeek Harness web app inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only; Linux support is preview and not yet validated on real Ubuntu hardware. Only DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 to 0.2.2-rc.5 is verified, and 0.1.2–0.1.4 are known incompatible. A non-loopback service address exposes DSH to the local network.
problem: Using the DeepSeek Harness agent means command-line setup and a separate browser window that is disconnected from the notes in your vault.

relations.evidence: embeds the native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI into your vault
whose select-and-send design inspired this plugin's bridge

summary: Desktop plugin that installs, launches and embeds the DeepSeek Harness web UI in a vault panel, with a two-way note-to-chat bridge.
